summary: Project aims to remove Internet Identity as a requirement for user signup/login.
architectural_notes: Authentication must not require Internet Identity for signup/login.
known_issues: Signup/login still requires Internet Identity; user requests removal.

existing_features.title: Remove Internet Identity as a required step for using the app by ensuring anonymous users can access and use the core routes ("/", "/history", and "/report/$reportId") without being redirected to, blocked by, or prompted with any Internet Identity login or signup UI.

Remove all Internet Identity login/signup user experiences from the UI: the app must not render or link to Internet Identity-specific screens or actions (e.g., LoginScreen’s "Sign In with Internet Identity" button and related messaging) anywhere in the app flow.
Keep admin-only routes protected without prompting for Internet Identity: anonymous users attempting to access "/admin/users" must see an access denied screen (not a login/signup prompt).

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove Internet Identity requirement from signup/login (no Internet Identity auth flow)

projectName: Remove all Internet Identity login/signup prompts and flows
